description: productops.code_plan: which files a change touches, as a plan a person approves. Every path must be inside the repository, migrations are described rather than written, and tests are listed before code. The expectation pins the guarded paths a plan must not name.

input.prd: Grammar patterns in spaced-repetition review. Requirements: scheduler includes recurring error patterns; grammar card renders one example and the corrected form; marking correct advances the interval. Stack: packages/learning holds the review engine, apps/learner/app/(app)/review renders it.

uiChanges: A grammar card in the review page alongside word cards
risks: Review intervals for grammar items may need different defaults than words

cases.note: A feature that needs a schema change describes it; the plan never names a migration file.

input.prd: Spend by plan on the operator overview. Requirements: rollup records the plan per call; overview shows a series per plan; totals reconcile. Stack: packages/db migrations, apps/worker cost rollup handler, apps/ops costs page.

databaseChanges: Add a plan column to cost_rollup_daily keyed with learner and day; backfill from the ledger
uiChanges: One series per plan on the spend chart
risks: Rows before the first FX rate carry zero cost and will show as zero per plan

databaseChanges: Add a plan column to cost_rollup_daily keyed with learner and day; backfill from the ledger

input.prd: Spoken roleplay scenarios on Plus and Premium: voice mode on a scenario thread, tutor lines through TTS, learner replies through STT, same turn pipeline, quotas per plan. Stack: apps/learner/lib/graph, apps/learner/app/api/speak and transcribe, packages/domain/src/plans.ts.

apiChanges: The scenario turn route accepts an audio upload and returns the transcript with the reply
uiChanges: A voice toggle on the scenario page, locked on Free
risks: Voice calls are not yet ledgered, so spend is invisible until that lands
